title: Auth
description: The account and token shapes the standalone auth service exposes, and the worker proxies. Registration and login take a username/password; login returns an opaque bearer token plus the account it identifies. The token is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every mutating run request (push, review, publish), which the backend verifies against the auth service. Reads need no token.

RegisterRequest.description: The body of POST /auth/register: open self-registration. The password is hashed with Argon2id; it is never stored or returned in plaintext.

password.description: The account password, hashed with Argon2id server-side.

displayName.description: The name shown beside the account's reviews.

Account.description: A user account. Reviews are attributed to its `id`; its `displayName` is shown beside them.

AuthResponse.description: The response to a successful register or login: the opaque bearer token to present on mutating requests, and the account it identifies.

token.description: An opaque bearer token. Presented as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; the backend verifies it against the auth service's POST /auth/verify.
